post.description:
Process an uploaded medical document.

Accepts a file upload, extracts text using OCR or direct reading,
and returns the extracted text.

Supported file types:
- Images: PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, TIFF, PDF
- Audio: MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, FLAC
- Text: TXT, MD, CSV, JSON, XML, YAML

Args:
    file: Uploaded file to process

Returns:
    PipelineResult with extracted text and metadata

Raises:
    413: File size exceeds maximum allowed size
    422: Invalid file type or processing error
    500: Internal server error during processing

get.description:

Serve an AWMF chunk's source PDF inline (scoped to the AWMF corpus root).

Force download a file with proper filename.

Returns the file with Content-Disposition: attachment for downloading.

Return metadata about the entry's source file.

Returns: exists, mime_type, size, can_inline

Get file synchronization status — cheap enough for 10 s UI polling.

Served from the in-memory sync state (updated by the watcher and by
reconcile passes); never re-hashes the source tree.

post.description:
Trigger manual file synchronization (admin only).

Runs a full sync operation:
- Imports new files
- Updates modified files
- Archives entries for deleted files

Lightweight file sync — link new files without running AI pipeline.

Scans source folders and creates database entries for files not yet
tracked. Uses link-only import (no OCR/classification), which is fast
and doesn't require Llamaserver.

Safe for any user to trigger. For full AI processing, use Admin sync.

Transcribe (OCR-extract) a knowledge entry's linked file — no LLM.

Runs the on-demand OCR seam for image/PDF, or a direct read for text
files. Returns only the extracted raw text; no summarization.

Raises:
    404: Entry not found
    400: Entry has no linked file
    409/502: No OCR backend available / backends failed (image/PDF)

Summarize a knowledge entry's linked file.

Extracts text from the entry's linked file (OCR for image/PDF, direct
read for text), then generates a summary using the specified AI
provider and skill.

Args:
    entry_id: ID of the knowledge entry to summarize
    request: Summarization request with skill, provider, and optional model

Returns:
    SummarizeResponse with extracted text, summary, and metadata

Raises:
    404: Entry not found
    400: Entry has no linked file or invalid skill
    422: Validation error
    500: Processing error

Classify entries deterministically by regex-matching folder + filename
against the classification library (data/classification_library.txt).

Symptom from filename. Then ICD-11 codes are enriched via the WHO API
(optional — requires ICD11_CLIENT_ID/SECRET in .env).
